mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force participation rate, as measured by PAYEMS, indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and employment (PAYEMS) signal strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and PAYEMS rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals reduced manufacturing output that lowers corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during supply shocks, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
